authority: POWO/WCVP direct species/rank pages; ITIS and USACE where noted

records.synonym_note: POWO accepts species and four varieties: acaulis, arizonica, caespitosa, epunctata. Species-only source does not establish variety; historical Hymenoxys/Actinea combinations must be checked with authors.
records.concept_action: Keep existing species-rank learner; no variety assignment or range change.

records.synonym_note: POWO accepts species with varieties scaposa and argyrocaulon. Homotypic historical names include Cephalophora scaposa DC., Hymenoxys scaposa (DC.) K.F.Parker and Actinella scaposa (DC.) Nutt.
records.concept_action: Species-rank source and project canonical species ID must not be assumed to prove var. scaposa; keep rank concepts distinct in research.

records.synonym_note: POWO accepts autonym variety; historical Tetraneuris scaposa var. linearis (Nutt.) K.F.Parker is a synonym of this variety. Distinct accepted sister variety argyrocaulon remains separate.
records.concept_action: Existing source variety represented within canonical tetraneuris-scaposa; no second learner card or automatic narrowing of species-only observations.

records.synonym_note: POWO/WCVP synonymizes Thelesperma ambiguum A.Gray under accepted T. megapotamicum var. ambiguum; alternative ITIS/Catalogue of Life taxonomy historically accepts T. ambiguum at species rank. Thelesperma fraternum Shinners also synonymized under the accepted variety.
records.concept_action: Preserve source name as alias to existing thelesperma-megapotamicum-var-ambiguum canonical concept; do not create second species or alter specimen ID.
